response.overview: Inside a network of glass terraria is a blue dragonfly named Simon, who struggles with loneliness as he spends his days performing monotonous office work. Collapsing from exhaustion one afternoon, Simon discovers an old, abandoned harp by the river. He finds joy in playing the mysterious instrument, its harmonious tunes unknowingly becoming the key to transforming his formerly-isolated life through music.
response.title: Simon and the Harp
